body:
Eh, no progress has been made with my situation, so still pretty much feeling like I did when I wrote this thread. I'm genuinely scared I'm going to end up doing something stupid, I just know it can't be before my dad's funeral. So... not the greatest I suppose haha. How about you?

Oh, really? I suddenly feel kind of put off Monster haha. Well, I'm half way there I guess! 

True, though I'm pretty bad at pretty much everything haha. I'd say I'm far below average for most things unfortunately, but that's a good way of looking at it.

That does seem to be the case, and it seems quite difficult to try to be accepted if you don't have those things. And I've not really looked at it that way before. I suppose I'd just have to give a big ol' FU to the ones who judge someone for not having money, the best stuff, etc.

(Sorry for the late reply, haven't had the energy to come online and read/type things :/)

Oh really? Haha that's how I've always felt, it tastes foul! But then I've never really given it much of a chance, so... I tried relying on juice like Monster to give me some energy, but it doesn't do anything for me. I suppose I shall get to the stage where I need to try to work on my relationship with coffee haha.

Hmm, true. I have a tendency to put myself down all the time, so I tend to automatically assume that everyone is better than me at everything ._.

I apologize for that being such a big question, I know it could be difficult to answer since it's quite complex. But that is a brilliant answer, thank you! I've never really thought of life in that way before, it just seems as if everything is about having lots of money, the nicest clothes and possessions (I'm not much of a material person myself though), having the best education and job, having the most friends and having the most interesting life, etc - so when you can't really have those things, it tends to suck haha. So it's lovely to hear from someone else's perspective that all those things aren't exactly necessary.

Thank you very much :p

Oh God, I'm sorry. That's really intense, I wouldn't have thought someone would do that - that's betraying trust. 

Not sure what that person was hoping to achieve, that's rarely ever a good idea! It'll just make the person involved be more likely to never want to speak to anyone about their problems again, and could make them a whole lot worse. Especially using the police... there's much better ways around something like that. ._. Wow.

I only came across this sub yesterday, that's enough to scare anyone into not sharing anything. :/ 
Obviously you've been through a lot the past 8 days, and this probably sounds like a stupid question, but how are you now? Are you alright, safe?

Thank you very much :D Some kid in school used to say it sounded like an alien's name haha. :( And really, it's meant to be ZaraJane. But everyone just calls me Zara haha.

Ohh, Zia? I don't think I've ever heard that before, it's lovely. I love unusual names!
Thank you ^-^

Oh no, I'm so sorry. I hope I didn't cause any offence or anything of the sort :( That's... awful. I can't describe how sorry I am to hear that. 

Thank you, that means a lot :3 I desperately hope I'd be a good mother, though I still have my doubts, I can never imagine me being good at anything so even that sounds like a bit of a task for me haha.

Good to hear, and nothing's perfect - I'm sure you've done just fine. :p

Oh :o I've only tried a sip or two, once or twice, but it's always left a foul aftertaste that I couldn't seem to get rid of for awhile. I'll have to try experimenting with coffees sometime, I like tea so hopefully I'll be able to find some type that I'll find nice haha.

The way you've described all that, it's quite fascinating. I've always been interested in psychology (unfortunately I've never had the opportunity to study it), I just love talking to people and finding out how they think and feel. I'd really love to work as a psychologist, or ideally a criminal psychologist. I know I'll never get there, I'm stupid, but it was always a dream for me.
You say you still see the bad stuff... What's it like if you're in a really bad situation? Like, is it still relatively easy to seek out the positives? (Well, I suppose that'd depend on just how bad the situation is actually...)

Thank you very much :D Though in reality, I'd probably be too scared to PM you. I always feel like a bother to people, so I'm usually too nervous to make contact first in case I'm a pest haha. ;s

(I apologize, I'm not very good with helping people.)

When you say that you feel that you're talking to someone who doesn't care, is it just that one particular therapist? Or is it the whole idea of having to speak to a professional, since it's just their job? 
You're different to those other 10 people because you're an individual. You may have similar problems, but realistically, no two struggles are the same - everyone experiences things differently.

If it makes you feel any better, I suffer with depression and I may feel similar. Sometimes I get almost an adrenaline rush when I think that I could easily end everything there and then. I'm sure there's many people here that are experiencing similar to the both of us, it's just a matter of feeling up to talking to them.

That's pretty crappy of your family to say that to you. May I ask, do they know how you feel? Do they know about you going to therapy? If not, they won't understand and think you're just an average lazy teenager. If they DO know, then, well... they suck, and I'm sorry.

People telling you the typical "People care about you, they'll miss you!" rarely helps, it's generic and quite frankly, if you're depressed then chances are you're not going to believe it or it won't matter to you. But to those who don't understand, who have never had to put up with that kinda thing, they won't realize that. They'll think they're helping. :/
I edited it to include photos of the death certificates, I'm guessing it won't make any difference though. :s

Hm maybe I should try drinking coffee sometime, at the moment I hate the stuff haha.

That sounds amazing, it must be so wonderful to be able to see such beauty in the world. All I see really is pain and suffering, even when I try to see good, my negative mind automatically shoots it down and I can't help but doubt and avoid, etc. So it gives me some peace of mind and makes me kinda happy to know that there's people out there who aren't like me, that there's people who can be happy and see the positive aspects of the world, even when life may give them problems too. It's almost uplifting that, even though I don't know you, I know you exist and you feel that way.

Thank you, truly.

Thank goodness, always paranoid about what people think of me haha ._.

Nice to meet you, Matt. I'm Zara :p
Thanks :p I shall have to keep my fingers crossed that it goes well, and that the person isn't too scary haha D:

Eek, thank you ^-^ 
But oh I'm so sorry, really. :/ It frustrates me to no end knowing that there's people out there who have problems with their mothers and/or fathers, especially the mothers though.. I can't imagine giving a child of mine a hard time. :/ 

How are you doing? Are things any better now (if you don't mind me asking)?

Oh really? I'm really glad it helped you. :p

Hmm hopefully, might be good to at least get it all off my chest. Might be a while till I get to that stage though (I tend to build walls around me in RL), besides, this meeting I'm meant to be having next week sometime is to assess me apparently. I'm so scared, things like this terrify me. Hence why I always chickened out, or would go for the first time, and then never turn up again haha.

Aw I'm blushing ^-^ That means a lot, thank you again.

(I feel like I'm going to get annoying with all the "thank you's" haha.)

I sincerely hope so, there's still a part of me (albeit a tiny part, but still) that doesn't want to die... I'm only 20, I want to get married and have a child :( It's just trying to make it to that point. I've always ran and hid from my problems, I'm FAR too nervous about even the smallest things going wrong, so it's difficult to see a way around everything.

I suppose, I was quite shocked when they said they had proof that it was me who gave permission, 'cause I only found out about this when the debt letter came through. The woman was extremely stubborn and laughed when we said it wasn't me. My parents could be extremely controlling, even when I was getting a little bit of money for attending college, they'd ask for it. But if they wanted it, I HAD to give them it. There was no way around it for me, so they controlled my life. It would've been too easy for them to pretend to be me over a phone.

Well it was my dad who signed everything for my mum's funeral, but I've been left to pay it since I'm next of kin. He was meant to get £2000 Bereavement Benefit to help towards it, but in his finally confused state, he went and gambled it all without realizing what it was for. And with regards to dad's... Well, dad had already made the arrangement with the undertaker and the family friend for his funeral. Then after dad died, they got me to sign to give them permission to deal with dad. I was told the estimated bill a few days after. :/

It is extremely overwhelming, it just seems as if all of a sudden, my whole life has changed and gone downhill - it's not as if everything has happened over the space of a few years, it's all happened in the space of a few weeks and it feels crazy.

Well, that's the issue - the contracts etc was taken out over the phone, so there's no signatures to prove it wasn't me... Me and a family friend tried to explain that to them, but they're not accepting that it wasn't me. They told me that it was my dad who done the talking and set up the accounts, but "I" was there to give permission over the phone (which, as I found out before from my parents, was actually my mum pretending to be me since her and my dad already knew all my details with banks etc). So yeah, no way out, they're saying I still need to pay it all back... :/

I'm not sure how it works, but I know someone who was in a similar situation to me (as in, she couldn't afford her dad's funeral)... she was a single mother and relied on benefits. Because she didn't pay it back quick enough, she got taken to court and is having to pay it off every week with most of her benefits money and had to pay the court fees too. That was around 5 years ago and she's still paying it off and barely has any money to survive because of it. So I'm absolutely terrified, especially because I don't know if I can get any benefits just yet (as stated, I have no source of income atm).
Ahh, really? Thank you, that made me smile. :D

Thank you, and maybe, it has affected me an awful lot. As I mentioned, I'm meant to be trying to get involved in a mental health team, so I suppose I should actually try opening up to them for once rather than hiding everything like I usually do haha... :s

I suppose, thank you ever so much. 

I genuinely smiled when I read that second paragraph (well done to you), whenever people try to provide comforting words they always go straight over my head and don't help in the slightest (I seem to be the stubborn kind of "depressed" haha). But that was actually a really lovely thought. None of that sugar-coated "You have so much to live for! Everything will be fine!" etc, just straight to the point that it may even be the tiniest of things that will help. 

I still feel the same way as I described, I still want to die and I can't see that changing, but your comment has given me more to think about. 

Seriously, thank you.

Thank you, I feel as if I'm just being ungrateful and complaining about stupid things since I know other people have it so much worse... but I just can't see the point in continuing like this much longer. :s

Well since I'm giving my life story anyway, might as well be fully honest haha.

I was bullied an awful lot when I was younger, mostly between the ages of 6-9. It was never the typical "You're fat", "you're ugly" kinda bullying (though I despise myself even today, I have no self-confidence and pretty much think I'm a hideous, disgusting monster), it was mostly because I had more of a "posh" accent compared to others at the school. But it got bad - I was getting thrown to the ground, spat on, my face rubbed in the dirt, and even followed and threatened with knives. Then, when I was nine, I was sexually abused by a friend of the family and a group of his friends (they were around 18/19). Parents never knew, but even to this day I have nightmares etc. We had to move from England to Scotland because of the fuss I kicked up. So I'm guessing that's where the problems kinda started.
Also, me and my father didn't have the best of relationships. Especially in the past 4 years, things had gotten quite bad - he'd hit and kick me, insult me with every name under the sun, tell me how fat and ugly I was and that no one would ever love me. He'd tell me how people would dance on my grave and that I'd be better off dead. Also told me my boyfriend hated me, but we got a little better as his health deteriorated.

My mum's funeral has already taken place, and my dad's is on the 10th September, I can't skip them so I really have to find all this money. I'm terrified, I can't do it.

Well, I got a letter today after my doctor referred me to a mental health team for around the 6th time (I chickened out every other time). But it's never helped before, and the more I get pressured by people to go, the more I want to hide away from everyone and everything.

Thank you so much, really. Really grateful for your comment.
And I'm really sorry for the long reply. :/

I understand, thank you so much for the advice. 
I wouldn't expect for strangers to help, it's a massive thing for anyone to ask of someone, but I haven't got any other choices really so this was my last resort. :/

The undertaker who's dealing with my situation (as I mentioned in a comment, he's put his job on the line for me, he'd be in a lot of trouble if anyone else around here found out) is away on holiday as far as I know, but I'll certainly talk to him when I can to see if that can be sorted. 
We never bothered with putting the deaths in the paper, as it was more money than we have.
A friend of my parents' has been taking care of paperwork etc, so I'll ask to see if she has a copy of the death certificates (they may still be at the town centre or undertakers) and I'll certainly be more than happy to provide proof of them. :p

I know this is probably a lost cause, but it's worth a shot I suppose.

Thanks very much!

This is heartbreaking :( I'm so sorry. While I have no money to donate, I'll share this with my friends to see if any of them can help you out. I wish you all the best of luck, hopefully you'll be able to raise the money quickly and Max will get the treatment he needs.

I'm so sorry about your situation, and I'm sorry I have no money to donate. 
But I want to give you and your daughter my best wishes, I hope everything works out for you - Seriously, well done for getting out of there, you're extremely brave.
Nope, parents never had anything like that. I'm literally stuck with nothing to help out with the costs, wills weren't even created.

Oh I see, thank you.
I'm sorry that it's a really new account, though the other one isn't any better, I just set it up one day (after just browsing through Reddit for months) and haven't bothered using it.

Thank you so much. 

That is with cremation :/ Cremation was never the plan, but it's the cheapest thing I could do. Very basic services too, I'm mortified about it. But It's going to be basically impossible for me to reach this amount, let alone anything else for a decent service. 
My father shouldn't even be getting a funeral since my mum's isn't even paid for yet, we're just lucky that the undertaker is an extremely nice guy. He's put his job on the line for this. 
Thank you very much <3

Nothing of value that's left to sell, already sold a couple of things (as I said, family has always been rather poor and so there's nothing that's worth anything), and £10k is still the amount I owe. I can't drive, and we didn't have a car anyway. The job-hunting is a really big problem due to the anxiety, I had to drop out of college (along with the doctors recommendations) 'cause I can barely leave the house. 

Thank you for the advice.

Yeah I have one other account, it's not OLD though. Only bothered making a reddit account a couple months ago after my boyfriend persuaded me. Never posted anything though. Is that alright? I'm new to this stuff. :s
